text:
maria: heads up — saw a small but reproducible quality regression after converting a HF checkpoint to Redwood runtime. short repro: chat completions start with duplicated short tokens and sometimes drop the leading prompt token.

ajay: ugh. which model + conversion flow? hf->transformers save? hf-cli? any changes to added_tokens.json?

maria: mosaic-chat-7b (community fork) -> we ran the hf_to_redwood conversion script (v0.9) and then quantized. suspecting special token/id drift. tokenizer files look weird. added_tokens.json has an extra empty-string entry at the top.

sam: that can change token ids for everything if added tokens were inserted with no explicit ids. can you paste the token id mapping for specials?

maria: quick dump:
```
# tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(['<s>','</s>','<pad>','<unk>'])
# returned: [0, 2, 1, 3]
# expected (from HF original): [1, 2, 0, 3]
```
so pad became 1 instead of 0. BOS moved to 0. KV cache alignment expectations in runtime assume pad=0 for some models which shifts the whole decode.

tess: is this from tokenizer_config.json vs special_tokens_map.json mismatch? HF sometimes writes added_tokens.json and special_tokens_map in two places.

maria: yep — tokenizer_config.json has "pad_token": "<pad>" and special_tokens_map.json maps "bos_token": "<s>" but added_tokens.json ended up with an extra "" at index 0 after conversion (looks like a bug in the conversion ordering).

ajay: quick triage steps: 1) compare tokenizer.vocab / merges or tokenizer.json canonical order 2) run small decode loop to see token id shift 3) try re-saving HF tokenizer with explicit special token ids (use add_special_tokens(attrs={'pad_token_id':0,'bos_token_id':1})) and reconvert.

maria: tried re-saving HF tokenizer with explicit ids and re-running conversion — fixed locally. reproducer attached (minimal):
```
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('local/mosaic-chat-7b-hf')
print({k: tok.convert_tokens_to_ids([v]) for k,v in tok.special_tokens_map.items()})
# set explicit then save
tok.save_pretrained('local/mosaic-chat-7b-hf-fixed', legacy_format=False)
```

sam: good. two followups: 1) we need a small CI check in the onboarder that verifies pad_token_id == 0 OR that the runtime mapping handles non-zero pad ids for models flagged as needing pad=0. 2) add a conversion-time sanity check to fail if added_tokens.json contains empty-string token or if special token ids change relative to HF checkpoint.

ajay: also check chat_template conversion — chat formats sometimes assume "assistant" reply begins with BOS token; if BOS id moved you'll see assistant responses missing or truncated.

tess: can we add an automated test: load HF tokenizer, convert via our script, then assert convert_tokens_to_ids(['<pad>','<s>','</s>','<unk>']) matches HF mapping? If mismatch, dump diffs and abort conversion.

maria: agreed. i'll push a quick PR to conversion script: 1) refuse empty-string added_tokens, 2) preserve explicit special token ids if present, 3) emit a warning if pad_token_id != 0 and model type in list_of_pad0_models.

deploy-bot: deployment check triggered for branch feature/tokenizer-sanity (CI: 3/5 passed).

sam: once PR is up ping me, i'll draft the onboarding check in the runtime to be defensive. also file a small postmortem so future conversions catch this earlier.

maria: will do — thanks. short-term hotfix: manual re-save tokenizers with explicit special token ids before conversion. long-term: conversion script hard-fail. :thumbsup:
